model: Compound from shared open-marked NAV. One position per symbol and one five-way slot reservation per admitted signal. No borrowing. Keep original orders from upper cap4 with 1h reclaim, using the corrected common-path fixed-stop fills.
capacity_rule: Do not reuse an occupied slot until the hour after exit. For simultaneous signals use frozen CRC32(symbol) priority.
selection: Choose the largest size whose pre-2025 hourly intrabar upper drawdown estimate does not exceed 25% under fees alone AND with additional 5bp per market fill. Report subsequent and continuous-history drawdowns against 30% without reselection.
costs: Market entry, stop and timeout 5bp, limit target 2bp. Separate same-order slippage overlay 5bp per market fill. Excludes funding and lot-size rounding.
float: Hourly marks including unrealized PnL. Conservative upper drawdown range uses simultaneous unfavorable extrema following favorable extrema and also reserves market slip and exit fees for intrabar closures.
